scope: Own implementation, exposed-development protocol, all 96 configuration and 2 control aggregates, fit summaries and verification receipts
included: Own Python implementation and synthetic unit tests
All 98 configuration/control risk rows and selection definitions
192 fresh-fit aggregate receipts, source freeze and batch completion records
Honest diagnostic report, limitations and reproduction instructions
excluded: Full per-epoch trajectories and model weights
Legacy experiment directories and saved models
Third-party implementation source and paper bodies
Raw exogenous responses, credentials and authentication-bearing URLs
existing_data: Previously published licensed source files remain unchanged; this delivery does not add or rehash full data files
reason: The public archive omits per-origin prediction NPZs required for local independent risk replay; public readers may inspect all aggregate rows or generate fresh predictions by retraining
manifest_rule: PUBLICATION_MANIFEST.json describes exact Git index blob bytes and excludes itself; earlier release manifests are historical
review_rule: SELF_REVIEW.json is primary-assistant self-review, not an external review
remote_rule: Only an actual remote exact-commit and file read-back establishes delivery; transport receipts are stored outside the repository
